displayPattern: Dishwasher display shows bE (also shown as 6E on some models)
meaning: Button error: the control panel detects a stuck button.
causes: A control panel button detected as stuck, the cause Samsung gives
diySteps: Touch every button on the panel
Turn the dishwasher back on and check whether bE (or 6E) has cleared
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If any buttons are not working correctly, or the code returns after you turn the dishwasher back on, Samsung says to request service. Not the same as LG dishwasher bE: LG uses bE for a bubble (oversudsing) error, which has its own steps.
sourceTitle: Samsung dishwasher is displaying an error code (Samsung Support)
